description: This file sets up a REST API for a Jira issue export/import tool using FastAPI, defining endpoints for authentication, project management, issue types, health checks, and session management. It imports external modules and internal services/models, and contains route handlers, dependencies, and startup logic.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service handling authentication, session management, and Jira integration.

classes.name: UserSession
classes.description: Represents a user session with authentication details.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Database model for storing project information.

classes.name: IssueType
classes.description: Database model for storing issue types related to projects.

methods.name: UserSession get_current_session( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Dependency that retrieves the current user session based on authorization.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify API availability.

methods.name: login(auth_request: AuthRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user against Jira and creates a session token.

methods.name: refresh_session( current_session: UserSession = Depends(get_current_session), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Refreshes the current user session expiration.

methods.name: logout( current_session: UserSession = Depends(get_current_session), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Logs out the user by invalidating the session token.

methods.name: get_session_info(current_session: UserSession = Depends(get_current_session))
methods.description: Returns information about the current session.

methods.name: get_projects( current_session: UserSession = Depends(get_current_session), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves all Jira projects accessible to the authenticated user and stores/updates them in the database.

methods.name: get_project_details( project_key: str, current_session: UserSession = Depends(get_current_session), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a specific project from the database.

methods.name: get_project_issue_types( project_key: str, current_session: UserSession = Depends(get_current_session), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Fetches issue types for a specific project from Jira and stores/updates them.

methods.name: cleanup_expired_sessions(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Admin endpoint to clean up expired user sessions.
